channel.title: Onchain Report
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades across the blockchain industry.

item.title: ICBA sues OCC over crypto trust bank charter rules
item.description: A community-bank trade group sued the OCC over rules behind crypto trust charters, seeking to undo Protego’s approval and limit the regulator’s power.

item.title: How Long Does a Polygon PoS Withdrawal Stay Pending?
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal often takes a few hours because it waits for an Ethereum checkpoint, then needs a separate claim transaction to finish.

item.title: How to Compare the Real Cost of Repeat Bridge Swaps
item.description: Repeat bridge swaps cost more than the quoted fee: compare route fees, slippage, gas, failed attempts and the value you receive before choosing a route.

item.title: Why Wrapped Tokens Stay Tied to Their Source
item.description: Wrapped tokens stay close to their source when each token is backed by a locked asset and redemption keeps that claim credible, but bridge design matters.

item.title: Bridge or Native Swap: How to Move BTC to ETH
item.description: For BTC to ETH, a bridge can give you bitcoin on Ethereum to trade, while a native swap aims to deliver ETH directly; compare fees, liquidity and trust.

item.title: How to Track an XMR-to-Ethereum Swap
item.description: An XMR-to-Ethereum swap can pause at several checkpoints. Learn how to tell whether Monero, the swap service or Ethereum is holding it up.

item.title: When Is a Manta Treasury Transfer Really Final?
item.description: Manta bridge finality depends on the route and chain: an L2 confirmation, a fast-finality attestation and an Ethereum withdrawal are distinct milestones.

item.title: Private swap relays hide trades from public bots before a block
item.description: Private swap relays keep pending trades out of the public mempool, which can limit copycat bots, but they still rely on intermediaries and block builders.

item.title: SEC proposes new crypto custody path for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed new custody rules for advisers and funds, including conditional self-custody, potentially widening access to crypto investment strategies.

item.title: SEC proposal would let some funds self-custody crypto
item.description: The SEC proposed letting registered advisers and funds hold some crypto themselves when no eligible custodian is available, with safeguards and board oversight.

item.title: Byreal: How to Choose Between Swaps and Liquidity Pools
item.description: Byreal users can choose a direct token swap or a liquidity pool by weighing speed, price impact, pool risk and whether they want to earn fees on Solana.

item.title: Bitget points to North Korea after $387.5m crypto theft
item.description: Bitget says suspected North Korean attackers stole $387.5 million through compromised security software, raising fresh questions about exchange wallet controls.
